Mod.Name: [Tsunamods] FF8 Gameplay Customizer
Mod.Author: Hobbitdur
Mod.Description:
► The ultimate gameplay tweaks ◄
This mods aims to bring lots of gameplay tweaks to FF8 and allow you to customize it to suit your preferences!
◆ Quality of life ◆ • DamageCapIncreased: Bring the damage cap up to 65.535. • NoMagicDepletion: Using magic doesn't decrease your stock. • DrawRework: Configure battle drawing, with separate Draw 100 options for field and world-map draw points. • AP: Earn from 0 to 255AP. Thanks to Satan-fatalityz for funding part of this! • EXP: Earn from 0 EXP to x16 EXP. Thanks to Satan-fatalityz for funding part of this! • SaveAnywhere: Allow to save in any field, but keep a side save on normal save point to be sure.
◆ Special thanks ◆ • myst6re for Deling tool and RE work • Maki for his work on RE • DangerousDom and Nihil for testing • SlimeBucket for the preview

LatestVersion.ReleaseNotes: • 0.1 Adding DrawRework, DamageCapIncreased, NoMagicDepletion • 0.2 Adding AP, EXP • 0.3 Adding SaveAnywhere • 0.4 Fixing field and worldmap draw for DrawRework - MaximumDraw. • 0.5 Split MaximumDraw into independent battle, field and world-map options.
